sources.name: California Energy Commission e-filing docket logs
sources.access: Public HTML docket and individual PDF documents read successfully. No documented public API identified.
sources.ingestion: Fetch configured public docket logs; identify records by docket + TN; preserve docketed date separately from document/submission date.
sources.cadence: Event-driven filing history; poll only configured public pages, with cache and low request rate.
sources.limits: CEC SPPE dockets cover associated thermal generation; they are not a census of data centers. Comments are statements by their authors, not agency findings.

sources.name: CEC power plant listing and project pages
sources.ingestion: Use filtered list to discover relevant project pages and docket numbers; keep original labels.
sources.limits: CEC states it does not permit data centers themselves. SPPE exemption is not final construction/operation approval; local land-use and air-district permits remain relevant.

sources.name: CEQAnet environmental notices and reviews
sources.agency: California Office of Land Use and Climate Innovation
sources.access: Public project pages and attachments read successfully; homepage did not yield text to the web tool. No machine API verified.
sources.ingestion: Manual/assisted keyword search, SCH identifiers, lead agency, county, received date and review-end filters; preserve each document version.
sources.limits: Not all CEQA/NEPA documents are submitted to SCH. LCI posts materials as received and does not review legal adequacy. A Notice of Exemption is not evidence of zero operational footprint.

sources.name: IDEM regional public notices
sources.access: Public HTML tables and linked PDFs read successfully. Regional email/text subscription offered; subscribing is a separate user action.
sources.ingestion: Track notice URL + permit ID + publication window. Search applicant aliases, not only data center words. Archive discovered notice metadata because expired notices may disappear from current regional lists.
sources.limits: Current notices are not a complete historical permit inventory. A closed comment period does not establish approval. No documented public machine API verified.

sources.name: IDEM Virtual File Cabinet
sources.access: Official guidance verified; indexed individual ECM record encountered HTTP 403 on direct open. Do not bypass.
sources.ingestion: Manual official search or authorized records request when automated access fails; link record IDs without labeling unreviewed content verified.
sources.limits: Agency says records are added daily. No public API contract or bulk-republication license established.

sources.name: IDEM air permit status search
sources.access: Official guide and indexed search instructions verified; direct search open returned 403. No bypass attempted.
sources.ingestion: Manual status verification by permit ID; capture draft/final document separately.
sources.limits: Permitted does not mean built or operating. IDEM warns its permitted-source list may include unbuilt, inactive, removed, or relocated facilities.

sources.name: IDEM water-quality Regulatory ePortal
sources.access: Portal inaccessible through web tool. The official Aug 4, 2026 notice explicitly directs the public to Site Map Explorer and the Documents tab. No API verified.
sources.ingestion: Manual portal search for Project Zodiac Phase 3; export/download public documents where authorized.
sources.limits: The portal reference is verified; direct data retrieval was not. Do not present as connected.

sources.name: Cleanview public tracker and licensed API
sources.access: Public tracker and API documentation verified. API requires vendor-provisioned key and paid access. No key supplied and no API request made.
sources.ingestion: Optional server-side licensed connector, disabled until credentials and intended redistribution rights are confirmed.
sources.pagination: No pagination; docs say all records returned in one response.
sources.limits: Public map only displays facilities with reported capacity. Status taxonomy includes Planned, Under Construction, Operating, Canceled; Canceled description includes postponed. generated_at is response time, not a per-record filing date. Do not sum campus and building phases indiscriminately. API documentation examples are not independently verified project records.

sources.name: TrackDataCenters user-provided discovery resource
sources.agency: Independent tracker; ownership/methodology not directly verified
sources.access: Parent research received 403. Public indexed search did not locate official API or reuse terms; robots.txt not retrievable by web tool. No bypass or bulk download attempted.
sources.ingestion: Link for discovery; accept user-supplied primary filing URLs. Enable import only after documented export/API permission.
sources.limits: Do not claim an active connection, comprehensive coverage, verified license, or validated project count. Third-party descriptions were found but not used for regulatory or project assertions.

qualityRules: Separate discovery candidates from reviewed published evidence; never silently promote extracted text to fact.
A filing can establish that a claim was made without establishing the truth of that claim.
Keep campus, phase and building identities distinct; prevent double counting of expansions and backup generation.
MW is capacity, MWh is energy. Backup generator MW, facility MW and IT MW are separate fields.
Keep planning estimates, permit limits and metered operational observations in distinct series.
Waterway and wetland permits quantify ecological disturbance; they do not measure cooling-water consumption.
Track comment-window end and legal expiry separately; closed comments do not imply granted permit.
Never infer public support from comment counts; duplicate campaigns and self-selection prevent representative inference.
Use quality-gated evidence for for/against arguments; factual uncertainty can justify requests for conditions or delay without asserting harm is proven.
Official-source polling is a proposed collection design, not a verified active service. Honor access barriers, terms and robots before activating any collector.

accessFindings.title: Customer-specific demand may remain confidential
accessFindings.finding: CEC determined that PG&E January/February data submissions containing customer and consumption information could remain confidential indefinitely. Public absence of load data is not evidence of zero demand.

accessFindings.title: Cleanview public counts should not be treated as an audited national total
accessFindings.finding: The retrieved page reports 3,612 total, 1,319 operating and 2,248 planned; the two category counts sum to 3,567. Capacity totals also do not equal the two displayed category capacities. Scope differences are unresolved. Do not import a reconciled total by assumption.

accessFindings.title: Commercial integration boundary
accessFindings.finding: API key must remain server-side; no key should be embedded in dashboard JavaScript or committed. Read access does not by itself establish republication rights.

accessFindings.title: Explicit reuse terms not established
accessFindings.finding: Vendor advertises paid platform/API and one-time download access; research did not locate an explicit license authorizing public dashboard republication. No purchase, subscription, or vendor contact was made.
